rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
fused sandhi form: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulaṃ; compound expressing attainment of powers as the root Kaula

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula teaching regarding the attainment of powers?
premises: The eight powers are included in this enumeration.
The attainment of these powers is identified as the root Kaula.
items.inference: Therefore, the attainment of the eight powers constitutes the foundational Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: The exact internal compound analysis of siddhisaṃprāptirmūlakaulaṃ may admit alternative segmentation.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
